title: 내년에 새로운 확팩이 나옵니다.
bodyHtml:
Sunsword(live producer, Origin systems)가 말하기를 내년쯤에 올드플레이어가 꽤 즐거워 할 만한 확팩이 나올것으로 생각된다고 UOSS FORUM에서 말하였습니다.

원문
==============================================================











Re: Will we get a expansion next year? [re: themagi]  


Wish I could give details, but we have to finalize a few more things before we can talk about it. Should make our vet players pretty happy though .

Anthony Castoro
"SunSword"
Producer, Ultima Online
